card.name: The word in after angle closure attack
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "may trigger an angle closure attack" in the antidepressant angle-closure glaucoma warning. It comes just before "a patient with anatomically narrow angles".

modes.label: Angle-closure warning
modes.description: The word "in" after "angle closure attack" in the pupillary dilation warning for antidepressants.
modes.example: may trigger an angle closure attack<< in>> a patient with anatomically narrow angles who

card.writes: It promotes words like "currently" and "recently", which suggests it prepares a time-related word after the phrase, such as a patient who is currently untreated.
card.plain: It marks the word "in" in the standard antidepressant eye-pressure warning, just before the sentence describes the patient.
